entities.summary: Urarina is a language isolate spoken in Peru, specifically in the Loreto Region of Northwest Peru, by the Urarina people. There are around 3,000 speakers in Urarinas District. It uses the Latin script. It is also known as Itucali, Simacu or Shimacu.
